text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Would you consider bananas to
be a
snack?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In addition to being packed with
vitamins,
minerals, and fiber, they also
provide glucose,
which our minds use as
an energy source.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I propose that they be
relabeled... as a
meal.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you have any arguments, let's hear
them—right
here, right now. We shall
debate this topic until
we both reach an
agreement.
